note: Every datagram was captured on loopback between two real Aeron C drivers; field values were decoded by an independent DataView decoder in the capture script. 64 bit values are decimal strings.

config.seed: none: no randomness in the script; drop is chosen by data frame ordinal

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.description: SETUP, SM, small DATA, heartbeats, EOS, RTTM request and reply (cubic congestion control)

scenarios.name: fragmented
scenarios.description: BEGIN / middle / END fragments of a 3-MTU message

scenarios.name: pad
scenarios.description: PAD at term end (64 KiB term, 1000 byte messages leave a 64 byte tail)

scenarios.name: loss
scenarios.description: relay drops the 3rd data frame: NAK, then the retransmitted DATA

scenarios.name: setup-elicit
scenarios.description: subscriber restarted while the publication stays connected: SM with SEND_SETUP flag
